svg.title: Order lifecycle
svg.desc: An order paid at once on the checkout sends order.created there, and the shopper is redirected to the next page; an order paid at a gateway comes back to the next page without it. A page whose URL has ref_id or order_ref_id loads the order: order.loaded, then order.paid the first time this browser loads it paid. If it cannot load, sdk.error. An upsell added to the order sends upsell.accepted, then order.updated. Each later page loads the order again and sends order.loaded.

text.tspan: order.paid comes once per order in this browser, on the first page that loads it paid
A copy loaded in this tab in the last 15 minutes is used at once, without the API
Paid at the gateway, the next page empties the cart kept for it, without cart events
Without next-success-url, an order paid at once goes to the store's order status page: neither event comes

tspan.style: fill: var(--color-rose-500, #e11d48); font-family: var(--clean-font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace)

text.tspan: → not loaded: no order.loaded or order.paid; offers stay hidden
